description: Import an official Pathrule pattern (a bundle of memories, rules, and skills) into the workspace when the user pastes a `::pathrule:package:<slug>` token. WORKFLOW: (1) First call with `dry_run: true` to see the pattern's `appliesTo` (stacks/packages/paths) and its pieces WITHOUT writing. (2) Judge fit against THIS workspace (its tree + stack). If the pattern does NOT fit (e.g. an Expo pattern but the project has no Expo), STOP and ask the user whether and where to add it. (3) Choose the `node_path` base that matches the user's actual structure (e.g. /apps/mobile) — the pattern's own paths are re-rooted under it. (4) Call again without dry_run to write. Pieces are path-first (missing nodes auto-create) and idempotent (existing content is skipped). Imported skills are tagged `pattern:<slug>`; the response lists each created id. Relay the returned human_message. Use pathrule_remove_pattern to undo a whole bundle.

dry_run.description: True returns the pattern's appliesTo + pieces (with resolved paths) WITHOUT writing. Use first to decide fit + base path.

node_path.description: Base path to re-root the whole bundle under, chosen to match this workspace (e.g. /apps/mobile). Omit only when the pattern's own paths already fit.

slug.description: Pattern slug — the part after 'package:' in ::pathrule:package:<slug>.

verbose.description: Set true for per-piece detail. Default false (compact summary).

name: pathrule_import_pattern
title: Import Pattern
